name: Scene Geometry and Scalar Range Initialization
definition: Constructs the scene geometry and scalar ranges for volume rendering by aggregating AMR box data, computing global bounding boxes via MPI, applying normalization scaling, and determining scalar value ranges (original and processed) including optional logarithmic scaling.
summary: Scene Geometry and Scalar Range Initialization pre-processes AMR data to establish spatial and scalar boundaries for volume rendering, distinct from traversal or shading.
